items.title: Oracle’s Ellison cancels plan to sell up to 50 mln shares
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oracle Corp (NYSE:ORCL) executive chair and chief technology officer Larry Ellison has cancelled a trading plan that would have allowed him to sell up to 50 million shares of the company, Oracle said on Saturday, adding that no shares were sold under the plan and that he has no other plans to sell Oracle stock.
